mechanism: Combination of SSRI and sympathomimetic with additive serotonergic effects and increased risk of serotonin syndrome, plus potential for cardiovascular stimulation and QT prolongation (citalopram dose-dependent).
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms; use lowest effective citalopram dose (≤20 mg/day in elderly); assess baseline and periodic ECGs; educate patient on serotonin syndrome warning signs.
